import numpy as np, json
def f(inp):
    inp=np.array(inp); out=inp.copy(); H,W=inp.shape

def flood(inp,seedval=None):
    inp=np.array(inp); H,W=inp.shape
    seeds=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if inp[y,x]==seedval]
    seen=set(seeds); q=collections.deque(seeds)
    while q:
        y,x=q.popleft()
        for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and inp[yy,xx]==0 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
